title: PokemonBondingDecision
description: Schema for Adapter A (Personality and Bonding Decisions)

interpretation.description: Interpretation of player interaction intent (e.g. praise, scold, chat, inquire_goals, discuss_release)

emotional_state.description: Predicted emotional response of the Pokemon (e.g. pleased, excited, defiant, dejected, anxious, curious, affectionate)

intent.description: Concise summary of the autonomous intention

dialogue.description: Authentic character dialogue, vocal cry, or physical gesture

rationale.description: Short explanation linking traits, trust, mood, and memories to this decision

suggested_alternative.description: Optional tactical alternative move name when action_type is suggest
